Normal-tissue copy-number caller

Source: R/caller.R
caller_normal.Rd

  1. null cells: the features' null_cell column, or select_null_cells() (null_cells = "auto" selects when the column is missing, all NA or all TRUE), never multiplets; 2. Student-t depth null per class x stratum and allelic rho on the null arm rows; 3. score_cells() with the normal state set; 4. fold-CV budget thresholds (budget_thresholds()); 5. per-cell calls by call_policy(); 6. pools within cell type (make_pools()) and, with an embedding, kNN pools (knn_pools()), pooled null thresholds (pooled_thresholds()) and pooled calls; 7. events (consolidate_calls()). Rows with eligible = FALSE are dropped first.

Usage

caller_normal(
  feat,
  params = caller_defaults(),
  cell_meta = NULL,
  multiplets = NULL,
  regions = NULL,
  embedding = NULL,
  null_cells = c("auto", "features", "select"),
  depth_model = c("t", "gauss"),
  n_draws = 20000,
  pool_classes = c("chrom", "arm", "50Mb", "20Mb", "10Mb", "5Mb", "event"),
  select_args = list(),
  sex = NULL,
  resolve_gains = TRUE,
  gain_min_dl = 0,
  pool_loo = TRUE,
  pool_standardize = TRUE,
  null_chroms = paste0("chr", 1:22)
)

Arguments

feat

features long table (vignette("scphasedcn-outputs", package = "scphasedcn"))

params

caller_defaults()

cell_meta

optional table cell (+ cell_type) overriding the features' cell types

multiplets

cells flagged as multiplets (never null cells, never pooled)

regions

regions table (default regions_from_features())

embedding

optional chromatin embedding (cells x components, row names = cells) for kNN pools

null_cells

"auto", "features" or "select"

depth_model

"t" or "gauss"

n_draws

null pool-regions per class for the pooled thresholds

pool_classes

region classes that are pooled

select_args

extra arguments for select_null_cells()

sex

"female", "male" (case-insensitive, or "F" / "M"; any other value stops) or NULL (inferred: female when chrX rows carry allele votes); sets the chrX rule of call_policy()

resolve_gains

apply resolve_nested() to the per-cell calls

gain_min_dl

min_dl_gain of resolve_nested()

pool_loo

call pools on the leave-one-out robust score s_rob (pool_scores())

pool_standardize

standardise the pooled best LLR per region (pool_scale() of the null pools of the same construction) before the per-class pooled thresholds

null_chroms

chromosomes whose rows can be null rows (default the autosomes, the chromosomes select_null_cells() checks); NULL = every null_region

Value

scphasedcn (mode normal) with scores, thresholds (column level: cell, pool_type, pool_knn), calls (cell and pool level; resolved for gains changed by resolve_nested()), events, pools, null_fit = list(tpar, rho, null_cells, selection, pool_scale, sex, vote_bins, rho_chrom) (vote_bins: the vote_bins() table with params$calib = "votes"; rho_chrom: the rho_by_chrom() table with params$calib_rho = "chrom")

Details

Calibration policy (defaults): null cells are selected on autosomal rows and null rows are autosomal (select_null_cells() chroms, null_chroms); per-cell chromosome gains need depth support and lose to a stronger nested loss / CN-LOH (resolve_nested(), resolve_gains); pooled state scores are standardised per region by the median / MAD of the null pools of the same construction (pool_scale(), pool_standardize), and a pooled call must survive dropping its most influential cell (pool_loo: pools are called on s_rob, thresholded on null pools of the same statistic); chrX pools are not reportable in females (call_policy() sex).

Opt-in calibrations: params$calib = "votes" keys the per-cell thresholds on class x stratum x vote stratum (hstratum, bins of n_hap of the null rows, vote_bins()); params$calib_rho = "chrom" scores the allele channel with a per-chromosome rho shrunk to the global (rho_by_chrom()). params$pool_tail_q > 0 (the default) adds a per-region tail factor to the pooled region scale (pool_scale()), cross-fitted with params$pool_tail_xfit (pooled_thresholds()). Named event regions (no null rows) borrow the per-cell thresholds of their sd_class (budget_thresholds()); their pools are called only with params$pool_events (experimental, off by default: caller_defaults()). Removed options stop with an error: calib "region" / "region_votes" / "votes_cont", calib_rho "cell" / "chrom_cell".
